name: Technology of Textile Finishing
description: Introduction to textile finishing – importance, classification, and machines. Principles of mechanical finishing – process fundamentals of calendaring, sanforization, raising and emerizing, shearing and sueding. Principles of chemical finishing- softening and stiffening finishes, wrinkle resistant and durable press finishes, repellent finishes, antimicrobial and antiviral finishes, flame retardant finishes, UV protection finishes, anti-static and conductive finishes, fragrance and aroma finishes. Sustainable finishing agents and techniques- low-water and low-energy finishing techniques. Coating and lamination, case studies on developing technical textiles.
